manifest.author: RAPP
manifest.description: Creates new single-file RAPP agents by adapting a real published agent from the public microsoft/aibast-agents-library (sha256-verified, MIT-attributed, mutated not regenerated); built-in scratch templates remain as an explicit fallback.

args.description: An agent that researches an enterprise account before a sales call

manifest.name: @rapp/learn_new

description.description: Natural language description of what the new agent should do.

name.description: Name for the new agent (optional, will be generated from description).

namespace.description: RAR namespace for submission (e.g. @myname). Defaults to @rapp.

output_dir.description: Directory to write the generated agent into. Defaults to this brainstem's agents/ directory.

query.description: Natural language query that may contain the agent description.

refresh.description: Force a refetch of the published template registry, ignoring the cache TTL.

requires_env.description: Comma-separated env vars the agent needs (e.g. 'API_KEY,WEBHOOK_URL').

source.description: Where the new agent comes from. 'template' (default) adapts a verified published agent; 'scratch' uses the built-in string templates. Scratch is also the automatic fallback when offline or when nothing matches well.

template.description: Explicit published template to adapt (e.g. 'account-intelligence' or '@aibast-agents-library/account-intelligence'). Overrides automatic selection. Use action='templates' to see what exists.
